notes: New 📅 Events button in the chat: see every character's schedule for any day, with what they're doing right now highlighted.
Upcoming events: see what's coming and add your own, either for one character (it moves them there at that time) or for everyone (a festival, a storm, a sale the world can hear about).

Menstrual cycles now run on the story clock: period days, PMS and ovulation, shown on a little calendar bar with the next period date. You can change the length, mark when a period started, or turn tracking on or off.
The narrator and off-screen scenes now know who's on their period or has PMS today, and show it through small natural details.
Phoenix, Dialyn, Zhao and Promeia have cycles; the character creator has a cycle option too.
Off-screen scenes in your own worlds now use that world's setting.
